[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for achieving the right consistency with black stoneware clay:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Wedging and kneading to remove air pockets and align clay particles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Conditioning the clay by wrapping it in a damp cloth or plastic bag.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Using the right tools like a wire cutter or needle tool to gauge consistency.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Performing the "bend test" to check clay's flexibility.
